header_sentences: See Gehenna, and Red Sea; and also see Cast, Cast down, Combat, Crowd, Deep, Devil, Equilibrium, Evil Spirit, Genii, Satan, Society, Subjugate, and Torment.

contexts.text: I have been instructed there about... Hell, or the lamentable state of the unfaithful.
The whole man would rush into Hell, unless the Lord had mercy on him.
Hell () = the Lower Earth.
That at last Hell originated thence. Treated of.
(The Antediluvians) are in a Hell separate from the Hells of others... AC 1266. AC 1267. AC 1271.
Some, after a longer, some after a shorter space of time, are carried then towards Hell. AC 2119:end.
Spirits have a most exquisite touch, whence the pains and torments in Hell...
On Hell. General article. AC 814. AC 824. AC 938. AC 947.
No two have a like Hell.

So hatred against the Lord, and against the neighbour, and the penalty and torment thence, constitute Hell. There are innumerable genera of hatreds, and still more innumerable species, and there are as many Hells.

So Hell, from proprium, through the love of self and of the world, that is, through hatred, constitutes one devil, and one mind, and thus regards one end, which is to destroy and damn all to eternity...

Such a form and order are induced on the Hells by the Lord, that they are all kept bound by their cupidities and phantasies... which life is turned into direful torments... For the highest delight of their life consists in being able to punish, torture, and torment one another, by arts unknown in the world... If they could augment pains and torments to infinity they would not be satisfied... But the Lord... mitigates their torments.
The Lord never sends anyone to Hell, but wills to bring all out of Hell... The Lord turns all their torment into good, and to some use...
The uses which the infernals can perform are very vile. When they are in them they are not so much in torment; but on the cessation of the use they are remitted into Hell.

That I might see the torments of those who are in Hell... I was sometimes let down thither. To be let down into Hell... is an immission into some infernal Society, the man remaining in the same place.
The abyss anciently signified Hell... Some Hells appear like abysses, and like seas. Illustrated.
On the Hells of those who have passed their lives in hatreds, revenges, and cruelty. General article.
Such as have deadly hatred... are kept in a very deep cadaverous Hell, where there is a stench as from corpses... They prefer this stench to the most delightful odours... SE 1288.
The descent of infernals into this cadaverous Hell. Described... When let out they have a kind of circle to which brazen spines are attached, which they press with their hands...
They live for ages in direful phantasies...
(Specimen Spirits from the Hells of hatred and revenge.) AC 817. AC 821.
After they have undergone infernal torments for ages...
He was among the cold infernals, and was sent into Hell.
Beneath the buttocks there is a horrible Hell, where they seem to strike each other with knives... This Hell was opened to me, but only slightly... SE 4049.
(Scenery of the Hells.) See Hatred.
Thieves and pirates among urine.
On the Hells of those who have passed their lives in adulteries and lasciviousnesses; and also on the Hells of the deceitful and of sorcerers. General article.

Beneath the heel of the right foot there is a Hell where are they who have delighted in cruelty and at the same time in adulteries... (Their horrible cruelties to each other described.) Compare SE 2643.
At this day this Hell is growing, especially from those who are from the so-called Christian world...
This stercoraceous stench fills this Hell, and ceases by turns... In course of time they are left solitary, and sit in torment, becoming like ugly skeletons.

Those who insidiously commit adultery by means of conjugial love and love towards little children... are in a Hell beneath the buttocks in most filthy excrements, and are devastated until they become like bones...
(The horrid punishment of those who deflower virgins.) This penalty returns many times within hundreds and thousands of years, until they are imbued with horror for such cupidities.
(The punishment of those who think lasciviously, and who turn everything that is said into lasciviousness.)
They who deceive men with acute deceit... have a Hell more frightful than that of others, more frightful even than the Hell of murderers. Described. SE 2857. (See Deceit.)
Others who are deceitful in nature, but not so much from premeditation... have a Hell not so frightful.
These Sirens are grievously punished; some in Gehenna; some in a certain court among snakes... In course of time they are dissociated, and become like skeletons from head to heel.
The evils of the will are those which... thrust man down to Hell...
The case is worse with those who from cupidities have confirmed themselves in falsities... These are they who sink themselves down to Hell.
Every man, Spirit, and Angel... of himself rushes to Hell...
Thus Heaven was separated from man... and at the same time communication was effected with Hell.

On the Hells of the avaricious; and of the filthy Jerusalem; and of the robbers in the desert; and also of the excrementitious Hells of those who have lived in mere pleasures. General article. SE 1292. SE 3211.
See Avarice. AC 939. AC 940.
On other Hells, which are distinct from the former. General article.
See Deceit.

There is another tun, as it appears to them, in which are some who had supposed, when they did evil, that they were doing good, and the reverse... They are as it were in a dream... On the recovery of their rationality... they are like other Spirits.

To the left in front there is a certain chamber... called the dark chamber, where are those who have coveted the goods of others... Their faces are... livid... with horrible fissures... from living in the torment of anxiety.
(Other Hells of vastation. Described.) AC 952-967.
Such could not but be kept in some Hell to eternity.

The voluntary part of a regenerate man is Hell; and in proportion as the Lord is present... Hell is removed; for of himself man is in Hell... and man is continually being elevated from Hell... and in proportion as he is elevated his Hell is removed.
Man's proprium is his Hell itself; for through his voluntary proprium he communicates with Hell, which is such that it desires nothing more than to precipitate itself into Hell...
(These women) do not undergo vastation, but are in Hell.
Beneath the feet are the Hells which correspond to those who are on high.
The love of self... is the infernal itself.
The Hells consist of such...
They appear above the head, but are in Hell beneath the feet.
Unless men receive a new proprium... they must needs be accursed to Hell; from which all are... continually withheld by the Lord. AC 1594:4.
The Lord fought against all Hell. AC 1573:4. AC 1680. AC 1820:5.
Still less could Hell have approached the Lord if He had been born Divine...
Hell consists of nothing but hatreds...
Man does not know... that Hell presses on him like the sea...
That the Lord's first victory over the Hells... as yet extended itself no further. Signified.
(The necessity of His conquering the Hells in the way He did.)
The Lord never began the fight with any Hell, but the Hells assaulted Him...
The Lord never... thrusts anyone down into Hell; but (the evil Spirit) precipitates himself into Hell. AC 1832:3. AC 1857:3. AC 1861:12. AC 2121:2. AC 5057:2. SE 4344. SE 4753.
From His earliest childhood to the last hour of His life in the world, the Lord was assaulted by all the Hells, which were continually withstood, subjugated, and conquered...
He who is in temptations is in the Hells. To be in the Hells is not effected by place, but by state.
If one (Hell) were overcome, another would rush in, and so on to eternity...
What is doctrinal... exists even with the infernals. AC 2049:3.
If he has self and the world as an end he may know that he is infernal.
In humiliation of heart... the mind lets itself down towards Hell...
From which they feel the Hell of self.
In order to save a soul from Hell the Angels... would undergo Hell in his stead.
All are not cast down into the Hells in a moment; for... everyone returns into the life which he had in the body, and is thus by degrees carried down into Hell.
Life is twofold; one infernal, the other heavenly. Explained.
If he has lived in evils... the Lord separates goods from him, and the evils bear him into Hell.
Divine truth condemns all to Hell...
He rather believes himself to be infernal than heavenly...
(At the approach of the Holy of the Lord) the evil flee... into their own Hells.
They call Heaven their Hell. AC 3938:6. AC 4226:end. SE 3660:end.
The exhalation of Hell cannot penetrate to Heaven.
There would not be a single one in Hell.
The Hell which is with those who are in the evils of the love of self and the derivative falsities. Signified.
Even they who are in Hell do not think from themselves; but so receive the good and truth from the Lord.
Hell is to will to be above all.
When at last they are reduced to a state in which they perceive Hell in themselves... this Persuasive is broken...
The Lord is present... in Hell itself...
Thus Heaven is turned into Hell.
The Hell of the deceitful is deep beneath the heel... Such are very numerous at this day... Their Hell is the most grievous of all.
There are many Hells of adulterers; they love nothing more there than dirt and excrement...
The gate of enemies = Hell, or the infernals, who continually assault goods and truths; their seat is... in the natural mind... Then the infernals are driven away from that seat...
Heavenly freedom is Hell to evil Spirits.
Under Bury, see this reference.
There are the boundaries, and Hell begins.
They who are in Hell are outside the Grand man, and correspond to the unclean and vitiated things. AC 3637. AC 3642. AC 4225.
For evil and falsity is Hell, and inflows from Hell...
The man would then perish eternally; for in the other life he would hang between Heaven and Hell...
Celestial men... in the Natural are so strong as to truth, that they can fight with the Hells... To good the Hells cannot approach, even afar.
In this state he is affected with the commandments because he fears Hell.

When it is given to look into the Hells... there appears a very dark mist, in which they pass their time... Sometimes a lumen is given them... and sometimes a heat as of an unclean bath... Their fury against good and truth, and against the Lord.

(Profaners) have continually in themselves what condemns them, thus their own Hell; for when the infernals approach the sphere where good and truth is, they at once feel their own Hell; for they come into what they hate, consequently into torment.
One Angel is stronger than a myriad of infernal Spirits.
The infernals dwell with a man in this affection. The result.
By evil ends a man is in Hell with devils.
The Hells, which are very numerous, also have a constant situation. Described.

All in Hell appear erect... but before the angelic sight the infernals are head downwards... For with the infernals that is beneath which to the celestials is above... Hence it may be a little evident how Heaven can make as it were one with Hell... AC 3642. Explained.
In this way the Lord rules the Hells.
They who are in Hell are in an atmosphere gross, misty, and dark, and are also in cold...
All men... have their situation either in... Heaven, or outside the Grand Man in Hell...
In proportion as a man or Spirit has the end of doing evil from the heart, he is... in Hell.

The Lord foresaw... that at last man would of himself rush to Hell; and therefore He has not only provided the means by which man may be turned from Hell... but also... continually bends and leads him.

The Lord foresaw also that of himself man would incline towards the deepest Hell; and therefore He provides that if he does not suffer himself to be led in freedom to Heaven, he may still be bent to a milder Hell. AC 8391.
In man... from himself there is nothing but what is infernal; and... his elevation out of the Hell in which he is... is called mercy.
Man, then... does not know what heavenly delight is, and what infernal delight, still less that they are so opposite to each other.
The delight of the natural man before regeneration... is infernal...
The opposite loves constitute Hell.
Deceit induces what is infernal on each and all things with man, placing evil in the middle, and rejecting good to the circumferences, which is the infernal order itself.
(Profanation) leads into a Hell the most grievous of all. AC 4601:3. AC 8882. AC 9049:5. HH 456:3.
Thus he makes in himself a Hell.
They who are in the truth of faith, and at the same time in no good of charity, are borne into Hell without such a Judgment; namely, without the conviction that they are in falsity.
Therefore they cast themselves to Hell, where such a lumen exists.
They are there among the stupid infernals.
(Such) have a place beneath the buttocks, where their Hell is.
How man... conjoins himself with Hell.

All who are in the loves of self and the world, and in the derivative concupiscences, and who only do good for (external reasons), thus who are interiorly unmerciful, in hatred and revenge against the neighbour, and are delighted with his misfortunes when he does not favour them, are outside the Grand Man, for they are in Hell...
They cast themselves headlong down to Hell, where they can breathe and move, AC 4459:5.
This camp, or order, is such that it cannot possibly be broken into by Hell, although Hell is in the continual endeavour to break into it.
Camp, here, = evils and falsities, and thus Hell.
By temptations He conquered the Hells; for He admitted all the Hells into Himself in their order; nay, even to the Angels...
Hell is remote from Heaven, because it could not endure Heaven... AC 4555:2.
The evil think, will, and act from Hell.
Even the Hells live from the same (one only) life.
The learned openly debate with each other whether there is a Hell, thus whether there is a Heaven.
They who are in the Hells are said to be in darkness... because they are in falsities... For they are in a yellow lumen like that of a fire of coal and sulphur... AC 4531.
Therefore they are in Hell, and are kept bound there in a spiritual manner.
So the folly and insanity which is from proprium is what reigns in Hell.
The Lord is everywhere present with light, even in the Hells... but the light is according to the reception.
This order is infernal; for Hell is in such order. Explained.
All that is not real which appears to those who are in Hell; for... whatever comes from the proprium of a Spirit is not real... Explained.

They who are in Hell equally have sensations, and know no otherwise than that it is really as they feel; but still when they are looked at by the Angels, the same things... disappear, and they themselves appear... as monsters...

They who are in Hell are in the spheres of such stenches (enumerated.) ... but they are delightful to them, and when they are in them, they are in the sphere of their delights... But when Hell is opened, and the exhalation thence reaches good Spirits, they are seized with horror...
(When I was thinking about heavenly things, it caused those in the Hells to think about the opposite things. Three examples.)
Heaven then receded from them, and in its place there came Spirits from Hell, who led them.
Beneath the places of vastation, and round about to a wide extent, are the Hells. Thus it is a little evident what is meant by Hell... when mentioned in the Word. Illustrated.

The Hells are distinguished according to these two loves; they who are in the love of self, because they are against all good whatever, are in the deepest and therefore most grievous Hells; whereas they who are in the love of the world, because they are not so much against all good whatever, are in Hells not so deep, and therefore in less grievous ones. AC 8318.

His Heaven is to will well to self, and from this to do good to others, when yet this is Hell. For Heaven is distinguished from Hell in this: that Heaven is to do good from good will, and Hell is to do evil from evil will...
For the Hells are very numerous; they are all distinct according to the genera and species of the cupidities of evil. AC 4818:end.
I have spoken to two who had been such, and who wondered that they were in Hell...
Beneath the earth of lower things, where the Hell of such is.
Beneath the heel, a little further back, is a Hell deep down... where are the most wicked. Described.
Therefore such in the other life are kept in Hell; and are in like manner kept bound there by external things...
He is then... disjoined from those who are in Hell.
The Hell which is beneath the places of vastation. Signified.
The Lord's conquest of the Hells. Treated of.
They cast themselves headlong into Hell; and the deeper down the better for them.
The Hell (of adulterers) is beneath the hinder part of the loins, beneath the buttocks, where they pass their time in dirty and excrementitious things...
The infernal Societies... operate by an ungentle and painful influx.
All evil is... from Hell.
From these fires the infernals torture each other in direful ways.
All those with whom the interior voluntary things have not been terminated, convey themselves into Hell; for the Divine flows through and is turned into what is infernal.
(Such) are voided into the privy, that is, into Hell.
They are thrust down into the intestines, and at last into the rectum, where the first Hell is... SE 1742.
The Hell (of the artful) is in a deep place beneath the right foot, a little in front.
Therefore it is that they who are in Hell, being against good and truth, are horribly deformed...
When they flow down towards Hell, they are turned into the opposites...
Hence the man who is in evil, and in the derivative falsity, is a Hell in the least form.

This way (through the bladder and ureters) is one of the general ways towards the Hells; the other is through the intestines; for the termination each way is in the Hells; for they who are in the Hells correspond to such things as are excreted by the intestines and by the bladder...

By this cupidity the Spirits (of the kidneys, ureters, and bladder) communicate with the Hells; and by the justice of the cause, which they inquire into before they chastise, they communicate with Heaven...
They who correspond to the urine itself are the infernals...
But the excrements themselves, which are voided, correspond to the Hells which are called the excrementitious Hells.
(The Spirits of the colon) extend themselves... towards Hell. In that Hell are they who have been devoid of mercy...
They then learn that to be separated from the Hells is to be separated from sins...
By death in general is signified Hell. Explained.
The Angels... can see each and all things... which are in the Hells; but not the reverse.
Communication from Hell is then opened to the exterior man.
There are two Spirits from Hell with every man... For man, being born in sins, could not possibly live, unless on the one side he communicated with Hell... AC 5849. AC 5993.
Because the human race from itself is in Hell.
In such a state are the infernals. (That is, of infernal order.)
When the infernals do not appear in the light of Heaven they have a different face from that which corresponds to their interiors. Explained.
Diseases correspond to those who are in the Hells.

All the infernals induce diseases, but with a difference; because all the Hells are in the cupidities and concupiscences of evil... and therefore they act into man from what is opposite... Hell, being in the opposite, destroys and disrupts all things... The infernals are not permitted to inflow into the solid parts of the body themselves... but only into the cupidities and Falsities. (Continued. See Disease.)
At this day such are kept shut up within Hell, and are not let out. AC 5719.
They are willing to be called devils, provided they are allowed to command the Hells...
They are cast down deeply into Hell. This Hell is towards the left, at a middle distance.
From himself, man is in Hell; but is of mercy drawn out thence by the Lord.
Such a law is derived from Hell... because in Hell all comrades conspire together for evil; and therefore, when they do evil, they are all punished.
(The infernals are punished when they do evil beyond their wont.)
Unless Angels and Spirits were with men... the latter would instantly precipitate themselves into the deepest Hell. AC 5854:2.
The Hells are most exactly distinguished according to the evils of cupidities, and according to all the differences of evil, (so that the like evil Spirits can always be called forth).

The evil Spirits with a man are from the Hells, but while with him are not in Hell, but are taken out thence. The place where they then are... is called the World of Spirits... The Hells are terminated in that World from above.
The Lord... could lead a man into good ends by omnipotent force... but the man would then come into... such a Hell, that he could not possibly endure it...
For to destroy man or any Spirit is the very delight of life of all who are in Hell.
There are two kinds of Spirits in Hell. (Continued. See Genii.)

The Angels observe whether any Hells are opened which had not been opened before, from which man is receiving influx, which takes place when he introduces himself into new evil. These Hells the Angels close, in so far as the man suffers it...
Hence all who are in Hell are said to be in night... They do see each other, but the lumen there is like that from a charcoal fire...
This is the infernal form. Explained. (That is, the infernal order.)
The Hells are the sources of all evil; and this is permitted them, because it is inevitable for the sake of man...

But in Hell there is night. There are also alternations there, but they are contrary to those in Heaven; morning there is the heat of cupidities; noon is the itch of Falsities; evening is anxiety; and night is torment; but... they are all only variations of the shade and darkness of night.
Heavenly love... in its progress is perverted by man, whence comes infernal love.

Unless the Spirits who are with man from Hell believed the things (of man's memory) to be their own, they would endeavour in every way to destroy man as to the body and as to the soul; for this is the infernal delight itself.
Man is conjoined with Hell through the loves of self and the world.
A man who is bound to Hell can never be loosed, except by Divine means. Explained.

There is another influx, not through the Spirits with man, but through others who are let out from some infernal Society into the sphere of man's life. (By conversing about things adverse to man they infuse anxieties.)

As to the origin of the influx of evil from Hell, the case is this. When a man, first from consent, then from purpose, and at last from the delight of affection, casts himself into evil, a Hell is opened which is in such evil... and afterwards there is an influx from that Hell. When a man thus comes into evil, it cleaves to him; for the Hell in whose sphere he then is, is in its very delight when it is in its evil...
That Hell through its Spirits continually injects evil and falsity... (has become familiar to me).
For the Angels to be able to avert the influxes from Hell, there must be with the man truths of faith joined to the good of life... If the man has not such, he is carried away by Hell.
The Lord's Divine Human, from which is deliverance from Hell. Signified.

Evil = Hell, because Hell itself is nothing but evil; for whether you say that all in Hell are the evil, or that Hell is evil, is the same thing. In the spiritual sense, when evil is mentioned, Hell is meant. Explained.

Sin, here, = Hell, which is at hand when man does evil. Evil itself also with man is nothing but Hell, for it inflows thence; and the man is then a Hell in the least image, and so also is everyone there.
The nations of Canaan represented infernal things...

That the sons of Israel took possession... of the land of those who represented the Hells, was a representative that at the time of the Lord's Advent the infernals had possession of a considerable part of Heaven, but that the Lord... cast them down into the Hells...
This (intensely gross lumen of the Sensuous) dominates in the Hells; and it is through this especially that the Hells inflow with man.
There are also Hells which are in a more subtle sphere. Described... This sphere flows into the external sensuous sphere... Hence the sensuous sphere is so strong.
(Otherwise) it might have been concluded that the Hells, which are in externals, could inflow into the Heavens, which are in internals.
All evil and falsity are from Hell.
The Hell (of profaners) is at the front part, to the left, at a great distance.
They would be tormented by the evil of their life more (in Heaven) than in the deepest Hell.
That the infernal and diabolical crew shall flee at His presence. Signified, Explained.
That from the Lord, through the Celestial, is the deliverance of many from Hell. Signified, Explained.
For of himself man is in Hell; for his will and thought from proprium are nothing but evil and falsity, by which he is so tied to Hell that he cannot be plucked away except by force.
But no one can be... delivered from Hell, unless... he has been in spiritual good...
The states of evil with the evil are retained and filled with evil, and by these they sink down into Hell.
That he is safe among all in the Hells. Signified, Explained.

There are innumerable Hells, distinct according to all the genera of all evils and the derivative falsities, and according to their species, and the singles of the species; and in each Hell there is order, (which) is preserved by the Lord, both immediately, and mediately through the celestial Angels. Moreover, Angels are sometimes sent thither to reduce into order the disordered things there... AC 7574:2.
Therefore at that time infernal and diabolical Spirits issued from the Hells, and exercised dominion over the Souls which came from the world...
The affection of the love (of self and the world) which inflows from Hell, commands violently.
In order that good may fight with the crew which is with man from Hell... it acts through truth.
One who was in natural truth... passed through many Hells... He had such power that the infernal Spirits could not at all infest him...
A wolf... here, = those who rescue from Hell those who have been seized.
Those in Hell look downwards from Him.
All in Hell think against the Lord.
They live in hatreds and revenges, and continually want to set themselves above others... and this they make Hell for themselves.
On the one side there is from the Hells a perpetual endeavour to do evil. (See Equilibrium.)
I replied, that his Heaven is turned into Hell as soon as Heaven itself inflows into it... Suddenly he felt Hell...
It was shown... that each thing of his life had been led by the Lord, and that otherwise he would have precipitated himself into the most frightful Hell...
As man has freedom... he is continually bent from the most frightful Hell into a milder one...
When a man... receives influx from Hell, he feels the life of the love of self and the world delightful...
In Hell the one chastises the other, according to the evil which they had actually imbued in the world...
Good Spirits... are excused; for... they know that such things are excited in them by Hell...
Pleasures and appetites then take everything away: in such a state are they who are in the Hells...
The Lord permits the infernals in the other life to lead the good into temptation...
The thought and affection of those who are in evil and falsity have extension into infernal Societies...

In the light of Heaven these appear... as monsters; so does the whole Hell; so do the Societies there; and so does each one in the Societies, with a variety according to the degree of the opposition of evil against good and of the derivative falsity against truth.
Extension of thought to (new) infernal Societies. (Explained.)

In Hell... in their own lumen they appear as men, but in the light of Heaven as horrible monsters... The form in which they appear is the form of the Hell in which they are; for each Hell has its own form... HH 131. [Swedenborg footnote 1.] References.
(Such) have communication with the Hells.
Round every man and every good Spirit there is a general sphere of endeavours from Hell, and... from Heaven. The sphere from Hell is a sphere of endeavours to do evil and to destroy...
(When evil Spirits have been conquered, they come out of Hell no more.) AC 6762:end.
(The endeavour and intention of the infernals to subjugate the good. Signified, Explained... Their atrocious malice and cruelty. No one could resist them. They are utterly unable to do good.)

The Hells are now immensely augmented from such... especially from those within the Church, on account of the cunning, deceit, hatred, revenge, and adulteries, which flourish there more than elsewhere...
When the infernals are infesting, they are allowed to attack truths, but not goods. Explained.
When the infernals try to attack goods, they are cast down deeply into Hell... Hence the Angels... have such power over infernal Spirits that one of them can master thousands of infernals.
Therefore they precipitate themselves into Hell, where they recover their life. References.
(Such) are cast towards the Hells of the magicians, which are in the plane beneath the soles to the right, a little in front...
They who are in truths are safe... in the midst of the Hells.
The Lord appears... to those in Hell as a dusky and black cloud...
This fire is what torments those who are in the Hells; for when the reins are slackened to their cupidities they rush at one another, and torment each other in direful and unspeakable ways...
This is why the Hells are completely removed from Heaven, and why those who are there want to be removed; for (otherwise) they are direfully tormented. Signified.
The Holy proceeding from the Lord... reduces all things into Divine order... in the Hells also, and causes... the Hells to be most distinct according to evils and the derivative falsities.

They are warned that... if they do not desist... they will be thrust down into Hell... But they persist in infestation (from) the delight of their life... The thrusting of such Spirits down into Hell is represented by the destruction of the Egyptians in the Red Sea.
The fallacy about Heaven and Hell, that... the latter is beneath him, when yet they are in him.
This (magical power) is of no avail except in the Hells where they are; and there only because illusions and phantasies reign.
They never desist, except through punishments... and afterwards by immersions in Hells.
They sink down like weights into Hell.
The universal sphere of Hell is full of the denial of the Lord, and of hatred against Him...
The infernals are such that they do not desist through exhortations and threats; for it is the delight of their life to infest the upright... which delight is increased by exhortations to desist...
They who infest... are the Hells; but in order to be able to effect it, they send out emissaries. Explained, Signified.
They who have persuaded themselves that faith alone saves, and yet have lived a life of evil, are in Hell rather deeply towards the right, a little in front.
They who proximately receive and communicate are simple good spirits... Thus the Hells have communication... with those who are being infested.

The cadaverous Hells, where are assassins and the... revengeful; and the Hells called excrementitious, where are adulterers and those who have had filthy pleasures as an end... when opened, exhale intolerable stenches... Yet, they who are in these Hells apperceive them as grateful...
A command from the Divine is not brought openly to those who are in the Hells, but exhortation is made to them through Spirits.

When the infernals are deterred by punishments from doing evil, they at last abstain from infestation... but as it is the sole delight of their life to do evil... they cannot abstain unless they exert all their force... to remove themselves. Signified.
The infernals who tempt cannot approach the celestial Angels; for... they are seized with horror and anguish... still less can they approach the Divine...
A bringing forth from Hell by Divine power. Signified, Explained.
The Hells (of Venus) appear near that Earth, and do not communicate with the Hells of... our Earth, because they are of an entirely different genius...
As evil makes Hell with man...
Fear alone can restrain the infernals...
The fear of punishment... is the reason of the torments of the evil in Hell. Explained.
Pools = ... Hell.
Hence it is that the infernals... cannot receive the truths of faith, and consequently cannot be amended.
Hence it is that the evil... after having been cast into Hell, are not allowed to reason from falsified truths, but from mere falsities.
They who are in Hell, from whom truths... have been taken away, cannot do otherwise than speak falsities...

(As) the loves of self and of the world with man make Hell (they shall be explained), so that a man may know whether Hell or Heaven is in him; for in man himself is either Hell or Heaven. The Kingdom of God is within man... and therefore so is Hell. AC 7369. AC 7371. AC 7376.
Nothing delights the infernals except doing evil...
There are ten states, into which they successively come, before... they are cast into Hell. Explained, Signified.
It is according to order that one plague shall follow another, and that the evil shall be thus successively cast down into Hell...

They who are being cast into Hell endure evils continually more grievous until they dare not inflict evil on anyone; and afterwards remain in Hell to eternity. They cannot be taken out thence, because it is impossible for them to will good to anyone. All that is possible for them is from the fear of the penalty not to do evil, the lust always remaining.
So long as they have communication with Heaven they cannot be cast down into Hell; and therefore these (doctrinal things) are by degrees taken away from them...
When there is no longer communication with Heaven through the things of the Church, the man falls into Hell. Signified.

Even those in Hell have communication with Heaven, but no conjunction through good and truth; for when good and truth flow down... into Hell they are at once turned into evil and falsity... Such is the communication.
Hence it is that the infernals dare not approach any heavenly Society. References.
The evil turn themselves away from the Lord... Hence comes all evil, consequently unhappiness and Hell, to man.
Good... becomes harsh and rough as it descends towards the Hells.

When the Lord ordinates the Heavens, the Hells, which are in what is opposite, are ordinated of themselves, and are removed from Heaven according to the degrees of evil, and are allotted places according to the quality of their evil. Signified.
These (Nephilim) were cast by the Lord into a Hell which is on the left, in front, at some distance.

By (the falsity) being cast into Hell is not meant that it was taken away from the infesters... but that it remained with them, and that by means of it they were conjoined with the Hells, where such things are; for the evil in the other life, by every state of evil and falsity into which they enter, are conjoined with (the corresponding) Hells. In this way conjunction is effected with many Hells in succession, before they are fully devastated.
For the Divine influx proceeds into opposites, and thus keeps the Hells together in connection and in bonds.
Hence it is that there are degrees of devastation, until at last they are cast down into Hell, which is the last degree of vastation.

When the evil are being devastated... they often perceive the source of (their) punishment, that they may know... that they themselves are the cause of it. Such things also often happen to those in Hell, when they are in a quiet state. This takes place for many reasons, especially that they may recollect the evils which they have committed in the world.
The more the infernals are in falsities from evil, the more they are averse to truth, until at last they will not hear anything of truth. Signified.

In Hell there is a form of government... The subordinations in Hell are those of command... He who commands is fierce with those who are not constantly at his beck, for each holds all the rest as enemies, yet outwardly as friends in order to form a league against the violence of others. This league is like that of robbers. The subordinate ones continually aspire after dominion, and often break out. Then is the state there lamentable, for then there are fiercenesses and cruelties. This takes place by turns.
They who are in Hell love themselves alone; and they who love themselves alone have no regard for others... except from fear...

That the evil undergo so many states before they are... sent into Hell, is quite unknown... No one is damned until he himself... is interiorly convinced that he is in evil, and that he cannot possibly be in Heaven... He is also warned to desist from evil; but when on account of the dominion of evil he cannot do so, the power of doing evil by falsifications of truth and simulations of good is taken away from him, which is done successively from one degree to another; and at last damnation follows, and demission into Hell. This takes place when he comes into the evil of his life.
That damnation shall not flow in from Hell. Signified, Explained.

The devastation of the evil... also damnation, and casting down into Hell, do not come immediately from the Spirit who is in evil, but from the Hells; for the evils which are there all come forth through influx from the Hells...

As the Hells are such, they are kept closed by the Lord; for if they were opened the universal human race would perish; for the Hells continually breathe the destruction of all. The death of 70,000 men on account of the numbering of the people... and the death of the 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians... was done by the Hells, which were then opened. It would be the same now...

The Lord does not present Himself to those who are in Hell in order to inflict damnation, but still it is His presence which effects it; for the Hells continually desire to infest the good, and... to ascend into Heaven... but cannot get higher than those who are in the last boundaries of Heaven... But the Lord provides that (the latter) are in safety... which is effected by His presence... and then when the infernals introduce themselves to where the Lord is present... they cast themselves into the evils of vastation, and at last into damnation...
(Passing through the Hells.) Treated of. AC 8125.
The Hells are as numerous as are the genera and species of evils. Each Hell is separated from the others as by mists, clouds, or waters...
In this chapter it treats of the casting down of them into Hell; for casting down into Hell follows damnation.

As to the state of casting down into Hell, the case is this... All the falsities with them are gathered into one, which is done by the opening of all the Hells with which they have had communication... When they are encompassed with these, they are then in Hell... AC 8210:2. AC 8232.
All temptation is effected through influx from the Hells...
In the last of temptation... they are as it were falling into Hell...
The Divine alone can conquer the Hells. Unless the Divine acted against them they would rush in like a great ocean, one Hell after another...
The Lord takes the greatest care that the infernals do not inflow into the Voluntary of man; for if they were to do so after he has become regenerate, it would be all over with him. Explained.
There are some in the other life, who, being in truth above others, are in such power, that they can go through the Hells without any danger...

The infernal Genii and Spirits can do no evil to the good, but they perpetually endeavour to do it. There is a sphere which exhales from the Hells, which may be called a sphere of endeavours to do evil... Signified.
In the Hells there is order equally as in the Heavens; for in the Hells there is consociation through evils... which is like that of robbers.
(The evil casting themselves into Hell of their own accord.) Signified, Explained.

The evils and falsities themselves, in which they are, torment them. But the torment does not arise from grief at the evil they have done, but from their inability to do evil, which is the delight of their life. For when in Hell they do evil to others, they are punished and tormented by those to whom they do it. Especially do they do evil to each other from the cupidity of commanding... But the dominions there... alternate by turns, so that those who have tormented others are afterwards tormented by others, and this until at last such ardour abates from the fear of the penalty. From this it is evident whence is Hell, and what Hell is.

They who are in Hell do not appear to those who are in another Hell, not even to those who are nearest, for they are completely separated; but they appear to those who are in Heaven whenever it pleases the Lord; for the Lord rules the Hells by means of the Angels also, to whom is given an opportunity, from the place where they are, to see all things which come forth in Hell. This is done that there may be order there, and to prevent one doing violence to another beyond what is permitted. This office is given to the Angels, and by it dominion over the Hells.
To look into the Hells, and to see what is being done there, is sometimes given also to good Spirits...
The Egyptians, now, = those in Hell.

An evil Spirit is reduced to will evil and think and speak falsity from evil... Before this he is not cast into Hell; and this to the end that in Hell there may be nothing but evil, and that the falsity there may be of evil.
(The Lord's presence causes them to feel Hell in themselves.) AC 8306, Signified.
That the Lord protects against all evils and falsities from the Hells. Signified, Explained.
That the Lord alone... fought against the Hells, and conquered them. Illustrated.
He who once conquers the Hells conquers them perpetually. Explained.

For the Hells continually want to lift themselves up; for they breathe nothing but dominion; but they are repressed by the Lord alone... Whenever they attempt this, many of them are cast down deeper there.
So long as the evil are not devastated as to truths, they are in a region above the Hells but as soon as they are devastated... they sink down like weights. Signified, Explained. AC 8298.
Depths = the Hells relatively to evils; abysses, the Hells relatively to the falsities therefrom. AC 8288.
Before the Lord's Advent the infernal crew ranged about almost freely...
The delight itself of those in Hell is to do evil to others...
This delight makes their life, which is infernal life.
To put to flight and cast out the infernal crew... is effected solely by means of truths.
Hell is deep down below, because it is furthest away from the Sun of Heaven...
The earth swallowed them up = damnation and Hell; as is evident from... the earth... swallowed them, and they went down... alive into Hell ().
That at His mere presence falsities of faith and evils of life cast themselves into Hell. Signified.

It is said that falsities and evils cast themselves into Hell, because it is the falsities and evils cast into Hell which draw with them those to whom they adhere... For falsities and evils are exhalations from the Hells...
Therefore when the Angels think and speak about the Hells, they think and speak about falsities and evils abstractedly from those who are there.
That which nourishes those in Hell, and supports their life, is the evil of the love of self and of the world...

There are two things which make Hell... evil and falsity; consequently there are two things in Hell which make the torment there; the torment in Hell from falsity is compared to the worm, and the torment from evil there is compared to fire.
It became putrid = what is infernal thence.
Unless created anew, man is damned, for he wills and... thinks nothing but what is of Hell.
Genii have their Hell behind man... but evil Spirits have their Hell before man, and also at the sides.

The Hells of the former are completely separated from the Hells of evil Spirits, insomuch that they have scarcely any communication, in order that they may be separated from the men of the Spiritual Church...
Such are all who are in Hell. Described.
Hence it is impossible for those who have lived well to be sent into Hell... Consequently, it is impossible for those who are in Hell to be brought out into Heaven by the pure mercy of the Lord...
They who are in Hell impute their torments to the Divine...
The evil are not sent into Hell until they are in the evil of their life; for when they are in this they are also in the falsity of their evil. HH 508:6.
Thus Hell cannot be turned into Heaven with a man.
They who are in evil have extension into the infernal Societies according to the quality and quantity of their evil.
According to man's ruling principle Hell if he is evil.
Deliverance from Hell by Him. Signified. (by the opening words of the first commandment). AC 10156, Explained.
The belly corresponds to the way to Hell, and the draught or privy corresponds to Hell... Thus it signifies evil and falsity injected by Hell into man's thought, and again sent back thither...

Hell is not faraway, but is in an evil man... and after death everyone comes into that Hell... in which he had been in the world. But (then) the Hell which was not perceived in the world becomes perceptible... full of all unhappiness.
(All these) are in Hell, because they are devoid of heavenly life...
Therefore all in Hell are veiled in dense mists; for mists are falsities.
The interiors of those who are in a life of evil... are open into Hell.
The reason those... in Hell still live. Explained.
Evil from the heart is conjoined with its own punishment; hence there is... a Hell for the evil.
Because the evil of the love of self is universally regnant in Hell...
(As physical influx is impossible) they who are in Hell do not attempt to look to Heaven. References.
To dig through into Hell () = to hide themselves there, thus in falsities from evil; for Hell is falsity from evil, because it reigns there.
Therefore they appear before the Angels inverted... Such are all in Hell.
There are two things which make Hell... with man... the falsity of faith, and the evil of the love of self; these two are conjoined with those who are in Hell.
In Hell have been seen those who were preeminently learned in truths from the Word...
Affections of evil and falsity... are heard in Hell as cries, if they are ardent. SE 4822.
They who do good for the sake of self and the world are in Hell.
In Hell too there are changes (of heat and light), but opposite to the former.
The error that the life of Heaven can be transcribed into infernal life, and thus that those in Hell can be elevated into Heaven...
When man is in externals he is in labour and combat; for he is in a life which savours of the world, into which the Hells inflow from all sides...

Those in Hell derive respiration... from what is exterior... and therefore when they approach an angelic Society... they begin to be suffocated... and cast themselves down headlong into Hell, where they can (breathe).
With an insincere and unjust man the internal man is formed to the image of Hell, and the external to the image of Heaven subordinate to Hell.
Hell is removed solely by the protection of Heaven...
As those in Hell are all in falsities from evil, they have no power whatever; and therefore thousands of them can be driven away by one Angel...

In the other life... truths are removed from those who are in falsities from evil, so that... they sink down into Hell; and when they are in Hell they are in terror and consternation at truths from good...
When born, man as to hereditary evils is a Hell in the least form; and also becomes a Hell in so far as he takes of the hereditary evils and superadds to them his own.
(Thus) the life of Hell must be altogether destroyed...
(Thus) the life of Hell with man cannot be destroyed suddenly...
Therefore, they who are in the state of Hell cannot be translated into the state of Heaven. Explained, Signified.
The Hells are remote from the Lord according to their evils.

Those in whom infernal loves reign are in Hell... For such as the love is, such is the life, consequently such is the man. Therefore everyone may know from his loves whether Heaven is in him, or Hell.
Those in Hell look backwards from the Sun.

The Hells are continually... endeavouring to destroy Heaven, whence there appears there as it were... a boiling up. For hatred against the neighbour and against God is seated in the minds of those who are in the Hells, and therefore they come into fury when they see the blessedness of the upright...
The sphere (of Divine truth proceeding from Divine good) extends itself even into Hell; but they who are there... turn it into the contrary.

This Divine sphere extends itself into the Hells, and guards them. Hence it is that the Lord reigns in the Hells also; but with the difference that the Divine sphere... which guards Hell is a sphere of Divine truth separate from Divine good. The reason this sphere is in Hell, is that all who are there reject the Divine good... Such a sphere in the external form reigns in Hell, but still in the internal form the sphere of Divine truth conjoined with Divine good; and by this latter they are guarded there to prevent one doing evil to another beyond the measure. Signified. AC 10188:2.
In proportion as a man recedes from the good of life... these degrees are closed... Hence it is, that all who are in evil... are in Hell.

They who are in the Hells opposite to the celestial are called Genii... The Hell of the Genii is completely separated from the Hell of the Spirits... For there are intermediate ones there who conjoin them, who are opposite to the intermediate ones in the Heavens.
Therefore, unless the Hells had been subjugated by the Lord... no man could possibly have been saved. AC 9937:3. AC 10152:3.
Therefore, it is He alone who still conquers the Hells with man; for He who once conquers them, conquers them to eternity...
The Hell of (the Fifth Earth). Described.
The wilderness and the land of separation = Hell.
The depth of the sea = Hell.
Protection from the Hells. Signified, Explained.
That these things are to be committed to Hell. Signified, Explained.
The will of evil, and the understanding of falsity... are Hell with man.
Where Hell is. Heaven cannot be... therefore Hell must be removed, that is, evil from Hell.
(In Hell they have the Lord behind them whichever way they turn.) AC 10189:3. AC 10307:2.
The merely natural man, unless made spiritual by the Lord, is Hell.
(The safety of Heaven from the Hells.) Signified, Explained.
With those in whom the internal man is not open... Hell inflows...
The love of self and the love of the world for the sake of self reign in Hell, and are Hell.

There are many Hells of profaners... The Hells of the profanations of good are behind; but the Hells of the profanations of truth are beneath the feet and at the sides. They are deeper than the Hells of all other evils, and are rarely opened.
For, when man looks from himself, he looks to Hell.
That Heaven and the Church are not with man, but Hell. Signified.
For those in externals without an internal communicate with the Hells.
The camp, when the golden calf was being worshipped there, = Hell. AC 10458, Illustrated.
That Heaven acts on the one side, and Hell on the other. Signified, Explained.
Infernal worship. Signified, Explained.
The loves of self and the world which are damned to Hell. Signified.
The gate of the camp = where the opening into Hell is. Explained.
Thus Moses represented that what is internal cannot enter Hell... For all who are in Hell are in externals separate from what is internal...

Every Hell is closed round about, but is opened above according to necessity... This opening is into the World of Spirits... It is said according to necessity... because every man has with him Spirits from Hell... who are in his corporeal and worldly loves...
It is this opening which is meant by the gate of Hell. Illustrated... These gates are guarded... by means of Angels, to prevent more Spirits going out than there is need for.
For what is external separated from what is internal is Hell with man. Explained.
(Such) a man is actually in Hell...
The external of worship and of the Church, without what is internal, is the same thing as Hell. Explained.
After death... the life of Hell is with those who have loved themselves and the world above all things.
The life of Hell is what is called spiritual death.
Evil is then said to be consummated with him, and he is cast into Hell.
The faith of falsity and the love of evil conjoin man with Hell.
Hell in the whole complex is what is called the prince of this world, and the devil.
No one could have been delivered... from Hell; for the Hells would always have prevailed, because man has become such, that from himself he thinks nothing but what is of Hell.
Because then there was deliverance from Hell. Signified, Explained.
For there are Hells around every man...
He who has not order in himself is in Hell, and is Hell in a certain effigy...
If immediate mercy were possible... there would be no Hell...
When the internal is closed there is communication with Hell.
He was then cast into the Hell near his own Earth.
The love of evil and the derivative faith of falsity make the life of Hell.
They who have Hell in them will evil to all, and perceive delight in doing evil to others...

The love of self and the love of the world, when they reign, make the life of Hell with man... and therefore they with whom these loves reign can receive nothing from Heaven; but the things they receive are from Hell...
These are they who have Hell in them, and who after death come into Hell, because their life agrees with the life of those in Hell...
The quality of the life of those in Hell may be inferred from the life of such when together in the world, if external bonds were taken away...
The life of Hell cannot be transcribed into the life of Heaven, because they are opposites. Hence it is evident that they who come into Hell remain there to eternity.
The Lord saved the human race by this, that He subjugated the Hells...
They turn (Divine good and truth) into Hell.
All things contrary to Divine order correspond to Hell...
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] The Sun of Heaven is thick darkness to those in the Hells.
Those in Hell turn themselves to the thick darkness and the darkness which are opposite...
There is heat in the Hells, but it is unclean. References.
Hence the quarters in the Hells are opposite to those of Heaven. Explained.
Those in the Hells dwell according to their own quarters; those in evils from the love of self, from their east to their west; and those in falsities of evil, from their south to their north.
Those in the Hells, being without truths, appear clothed in garments ragged, squalid, and filthy, each according to his insanity...
It is because they are in a contrary state that the Hells are entirely separated from the Heavens.

There are also governments in the Hells... but the governments there are... all of the love of self. Everyone there wants to command others and to be preeminent. They hate those who do not favour them, and exercise vengeance and cruelty upon them... Therefore the more malignant are set over them, whom they obey from fear.
All in the Hells are in falsities from evil, and therefore they have no power against truth and good...
Therefore all in Hell are utterly against innocence... Hence they cannot endure the sight of infants; as soon as they see them they are inflamed with a cruel desire to hurt them.
The communication of Hell with evil Spirits. Explained.
Thus is an evil man conjoined with Hell.
That Heaven and Hell are from the human race. General article. LJ 14. HH 544:end.
Hell in the whole complex is what is called the devil and Satan; the Hell at the back... the devil, and the Hell at the front Satan. HH 544.
In proportion as the interiors are closed... he looks to Hell... They who receive the world (only), receive Hell.
No one is born for Hell... HH 329:end.
(Such rich men) are in Hell, where are filth, misery, and want.
In adulteries the Angels see the marriage of falsity and evil, which is Hell.
All in Hell are against marriage love...
(Thus) the delight reigning in Hell is the delight of adultery...
Some (angelic Societies) are present with those in the Hells, to restrain them from tormenting each other beyond the prescribed limits.

Why Hell is separated from Heaven. For all in Hell had been in... the sole delights of the body... from the love of self and of the world... So that a Spirit who is in Hell dare not put a finger out...
The Hell of one is never exactly like that of another...
The state of Hell with man is the conjunction of evil and falsity with him... HH 425, Explained.

Beneath (the World of Spirits) are the Hells... All the Hells are closed towards that World; they open only through holes and clefts, as of rocks; and through wide openings which are guarded, to prevent anyone from coming out except by permission... These are what are called the gates of Hell...

The gates and doors to the Hells do not appear, except to those who are about to enter... When they are opened, there appear dusky and as it were sooty caverns, tending obliquely downwards, where again there are a number of doors. Though these caverns exhale nauseous and fetid stenches... which evil Spirits seek for, Explained.
There are also with every man two gates, one of which opens towards Hell... The gate of Hell is open with those who are in evil and... falsity...

The things which are below the rational mind correspond to Hell... The things above it are closed against the influx of good and truth with those who are being prepared for Hell. Hence they cannot but look... to Hell... (that is) back from the Lord to the opposite centre, to which all things of Hell incline.
In proportion to the perfection... of the external and internal senses with the Angels... is the imperfection of them with those in Hell.
a. 7. On these things being disclosed, he was judged to Hell.
That a man who has bodily and worldly love, without celestial and spiritual love, comes into Hell. General article.

Some are cast into Hell immediately after death... (They are) those who have been interiorly wicked, and exteriorly as to the appearance good, thus who have tilled their malignity with deceit, and have used goodness as a means of deceiving...
When this second state is ended, the evil Spirit casts himself into the Hell where his like are...
Some evil Spirits, in this second state, by turns enter the Hells and come out again...

The Society in which they had been... is shown them... that they may know that they had been in Hell even in the life of the body; but still not in a like state to those who are in Hell itself, but in a like state to those who are in the World of Spirits.

The third state is... not for those who come into Hell, because they cannot be instructed; and their second state is also their third, ending in this, that they are completely turned to their own love, thus to the infernal Society which is in the like love... They then think and will from that love, (thus) they will nothing but evil, and think nothing but falsity...
(Title). On Hell.
That the Lord rules the Hells. General article.

The sphere of falsity from evil flowing forth from Hell, is as a perpetual endeavour to destroy all good and truth, conjoined with... a fury at not being able to do so; especially is it an endeavour to destroy the Divine of the Lord...
Hence there is all power in Heaven; and none in Hell.

Hell (too) is distinguished into Societies; and also into as many Societies as Heaven; for each Society in Heaven has a Society opposite to it in Hell, for the sake of the equilibrium... On this account the Lord continually provides that every Society of Heaven may have its opposite in a Society of Hell...
Therefore, there are as many Hells as there are Societies of Heaven; for... each Society of Hell is a Hell in a less form. HH 588.

As in general there are three Heavens, so also in general there are three Hells; the lowest one being opposite to the Third Heaven, the middle one to the Second Heaven, and the higher one to the First Heaven.

The Hells are ruled in general by a general afflux of Divine good and Divine truth from the Heavens, by which the general endeavour flowing forth from the Hells is restrained; and also by a special afflux from each Heaven, and from each Society of Heaven. The Hells are ruled in particular by Angels, to whom it is given to look into the Hells, and to restrain the insanities and disturbances there. Sometimes also Angels are sent thither... In general, all in the Hells are ruled by fears; some by fears implanted... in the world... and also by fears of penalties... The penalties there are manifold... For the most part the more malignant are set over the rest... who keep them in compliance... by penalties... These governors dare not pass beyond the limits prescribed to them... The fear of punishment is the only means of restraining the violence... of those who are in the Hells...
That the Lord casts no one down into Hell, but that the Spirit casts himself down. General article.
(Thus) man does evil from Hell...
Evil with min is Hell with him; for whether you say evil, or Hell, it is the same.
Now as man is the cause of his own evil, he leads himself into Hell...
Hence the man who is in evil is tied to Hell; and is actually there as to his spirit; and after death desires nothing more than to be where his evil is...
(How a man after death casts himself into Hell. Described.)
He then turns... his face to the Hell with which he had been conjoined in the world.
They enter of their own accord; and those who enter from an ardent love of evil appear to be cast in headlong... This is why they seem to be cast into Hell by Divine power.
That all in the Hells are in evils and derivative falsities from the loves of self and of the world. General article.
No one in the Hells is in evils and at the same time in truths...

Every evil Spirit is reduced into this state before He is cast into Hell. Described, References. [Swedenborg footnote 1.] That all in Hell speak falsities from evil. References. [Swedenborg footnote 1.]
All Spirits in the Hells, when looked at in any light of Heaven, appear in the form of their own evil... Described.

In general, their faces are... like those of corpses; with some they are black; with some fiery... with some disfigured with pimples, warts, and ulcers; with some no face appears, but in its stead something hairy or bony; and with some there are only teeth. Their bodies are monstrous. Their speech is like that of anger, hatred, or revenge... They are all images of their own Hell.
The form of Hell itself in general it has not been granted to see. I have only been told that... the universal Hell... resembles one devil...

But in what form the specific Hells are, or the infernal Societies, it has often been granted me to see; for at their apertures... appears a monster, which represents in general the form of those within...
When any light of Heaven inflows, their lumen is turned into thick darkness. Hence it is that the Hells are said to be in darkness...
What infernal fire is, and the gnashing of teeth. General article.
Infernal fire comes forth from the same origin as heavenly fire... but it is made infernal by those who receive it. Explained.
Under Fire, see this reference. HH 572.
(Their heat and light are rarely extinguished by the influx of heavenly heat and light.) Only when violent outrages are to be appeased...
All the Hells are such Societies; and therefore everyone there hates the others...
(How it is that evil Spirits cast themselves into Hell), when yet in Hell there are such torments. Explained.

When a Spirit thus enters Hell of his own accord... he is at first received in a friendly way... but this lasts only some hours. Meanwhile he is examined in respect to his cunning and power. (Then) they begin to infest him... with greater and greater severity... which is done by introduction more deeply into Hell... After the infestations they begin to inflict cruel penalties on him, until he is reduced to the state of a slave. But as there are continual rebellions there... those who have been made slaves are taken out of their thraldom to aid some new devil to subjugate others; and then those who do not submit... are in their turn tormented; and so on continually. Such are the torments of Hell, which are called infernal fire.

The gnashing of teeth is the continual disputing... of those in falsities, joined with contempt, enmity, mockery, ridicule, and reviling... In these Hells are all who have acknowledged nature and denied the Divine; in the deeper Hells are they who have confirmed themselves therein...
Those in evils from the love of the world are in the Hells in front, and are called Spirits... Their Hells are milder.
By these arts they torment each other in the Hells. Enumerated.
Why the Lord permits the torments in the Hells.
On the appearance, situation, and plurality of the Hells. General article.
Beneath both (the Heavens and the World of Spirits) are the Hells.
The Hells do not appear... except the entrances... when they are opened... All the gates to the Hells open from the World of Spirits...
There are Hells everywhere; under the mountains, hills, and rocks; and also beneath the plains and valleys. HH 588:end.
See Gate. HH 585.

It has been granted to look into the Hells... Some Hells appeared like caverns and dens in rocks tending inwards... Some like the caves and dens which wild beasts inhabit in forests; some like arched caverns and holes, such as are seen in mines...

Most of the Hells are threefold; the higher ones appear in thick darkness within, because there they are in the falsities of evil; but the lower ones appear fiery, because there they are in the evils themselves... In the deeper Hells are those who have acted interiorly from evil; but in the less deep ones are those who have acted exteriorly; that is, from the falsities of evil.

In some Hells there appear as it were ruins of houses and cities after a fire, in which the infernal Spirits dwell. In the milder Hells appear rude huts, in some cases contiguous, like a city. Inside the houses are infernal Spirits, engaged in continual quarrels... and fightings; in the streets robberies... are committed. In some Hells there are mere brothels... filled with every kind of dirt and excrement. There are also thick forests, in which infernal spirits wander about like wild beasts; and there also there are subterranean caves, into which they flee when pursued by others. There are also deserts... sandy, and in some places ragged rocks, in which are caverns; in some places there are also huts. Into these deserts are cast out from the Hells those who have suffered extreme things, especially those who... have been more cunning than others... Their final end is such a life.
As to the situation of the Hells in special, it can be known... to the Lord alone; yet their situation in general is known from the quarters in which they are.

Hence the Hells in the west are the worst of all... being worse and more horrible as they are remote from the east... In these Hells are they who have been in the love of self... In the most remote Hells in this quarter are they who have been of the Catholic religion... and have desired to be worshipped as gods... LJCont 62.

The most frightful Hells of this kind are at the sides, towards the northern quarter, and the less frightful ones are towards the southern quarter; thus the frightfulness of the Hells decreases from the northern quarter to the southern, and also by degrees towards the east...
In the eastern quarter at this day there are no Hells; those which were there have been translated to the western quarter in front.

The Hells in the northern and southern quarters are numerous; in these are they who... have been in the love of the world, and thence in... enmity, theft, cunning, avarice, and unmercifulness. The worst Hells of this kind are in the northern quarter... Their direfulness increases according to their proximity to the western quarter...

Behind the Hells in the western quarter are dark forests, in which malignant Spirits wander about like wild beasts. In like manner behind the Hells in the northern quarter. But behind the Hells in the southern quarter are the deserts...
The Hells are ordinately distinguished according to the differences of every evil, so that nothing could be more ordinate and distinct...
There are Hells beneath Hells. Some of them communicate by passages; many by exhalations...
The whole Heaven and World of Spirits are as it were excavated, and under them is a continuous Hell.
On the equilibrium between Heaven and Hell. General article.
From proprium all tend to Hell.
All the Hells act as one... and the Divine alone... can resist all the Hells...
It is continually provided... that no infernal Society beneath a heavenly one shall prevail over it, (Explained.)

The means (of adjusting the equilibrium) are many. Some relate to the stronger presence of the Lord... some to the ejection of superfluous infernal Spirits into the deserts; some to the transference of certain Spirits from one Hell to another; some to the ordination of those who are in the Hells... some to the hiding of certain Hells under denser and grosser coverings: also to the letting down of them to greater depths.
The Hells are continually assaulting Heaven... I have perceived the boilings up of some of the Hells...
As those in the Hells cannot be saved... the outrages in the Hells are subdued as much as possible, and the cruelties are restrained...

The Hells also are distinguished into two kingdoms... The one opposite the Celestial Kingdom is in the western quarter, and its inhabitants are called Genii; and the one opposite the Spiritual Kingdom is in the northern and southern quarters, and its inhabitants are called Spirits... DLW 273:4.
It is constantly provided... that nothing shall flow forth from the Hells opposite the Celestial Kingdom towards those who are in the Spiritual Kingdom...
No Spirits from Hell itself... are with man. By evil Spirits in the World of Spirits man is conjoined with Hell...
The loves of self and the world make Hell with man...
On Heaven and Hell. Chapter. (From AC 10714 et seq.)
There is an extension of all affections of evil and falsity into Hell...
Those in Hell, also, have this inmost degree of life...
Every Society... forms three Heavens, and three Hells beneath them...
These doctrinal things had been dictated from the deepest Hell...
Some of the Papists were cast into the Hells of the Gentiles.
A black soil, beneath which is their Hell.
These gulfs, and this sea, are their Hells...
(Position of the Hells of the Reformed.)
The Lord conjoins the Heavens and the Hells by oppositions.
Many... cast hither and thither into gulfs marshes, pools, and deserts, which are so many Hells.
Melancthon... in Hell by turns. SE 6040.
(The subjugation of the Hells by the Lord. Treated of in the Prophets). DLord 12, General article. DLord 18:2. DLord 33:2.
(Thus) when man... conquers in temptations, he is drawn out of Hell...
Before the Lord's Advent, the Hells had grown to such a height... AR 829.
Before the Last Judgment, the power of Hell prevailed over that of Heaven... DLord 65.
But this state of power of Hell was completely broken by the Last Judgment...
Those in Hell... will not hear about God, and cannot name Him.
While in the world, man is between Hell and Heaven; Hell is beneath... If he turns to Hell, he turns away from Heaven...
So long as concupiscences block up the interiors of the natural mind, the man is in Hell...
It is a universal of faith that the Lord came into the world to remove Hell from man... Thus He holds Hell subjugated in order and in obedience to Him to eternity. AR 67. BE 116. TCR 2.
The Hells under them are remote according to the rejection of love and wisdom.
The denial of God makes Hell; and, in the Christian world, the denial of the Lord's Divinity.
To turn the back to Him is to turn to Hell.
Hell is divided into Societies according to all the differences of... infernal loves.

Then... conjunction with Hell takes place.
The sensuous... after death are in Hell.
Then, by no inversion or retorsion, can he be reduced into the opposite state, and thus be drawn out of Hell.

That the three degrees of the natural mind, which is a form and image of Hell, are opposite to the three degrees of the spiritual mind... General article.
There are three Hells... distinct according to three degrees of height... the lowest Hell being opposite to the highest Heaven, (and so on).

The loves of self and the world make the inmost degree in the Hells... Folly and insanity... from their loves make the middle degree in the Hells... And the things concluded from their two degrees, which become either knowledges or acts, make the outermost degree in the Hells.
How the goods and truths of Heaven are turned into... the opposites in the Hells. Shown by experiment. DLW 348. TCR 492.

He is dead, whose mind is a Hell.
That evil uses... arose together with Hell. General article.
That all things which are evil uses are in Hell. General article.
Noxious things are produced on Earth by influx from Hell by the same law of permission by which evils themselves inflow thence with men.
That the influx from Hell operates... evil uses in places where there are things which correspond. General article.

The Hells are therefore named from their various stenches. Enumerated... But all these Hells are covered... If they are opened even a little... they excite vomiting and oppressive headaches; and those Hells which are also poisonous cause swoons. Their very dust is of the same nature...

That these Hells have not only communication, but also conjunction with such things in earth, may be concluded from this, that the Hells are not remote from men, but are around them, nay, are in those who are evil; thus they are contiguous to the earths.
The ultimate Spiritual... is separated from its higher degrees in the men of whom Hell consists.
(Thus) it is Hell which produces evil uses.
Hence he who casts down his mind to Hell, is cast down thither whole.
Therefore the universal Hell before the Lord is not only as nothing, but it is utterly nothing as to power...
The Kingdom of the Lord, which is... also over Hell, is a kingdom of uses.
The influx of... Hell is into the love of evil and through these into the and its... concupiscences perceptions and thoughts.
But after they have entered Hell, these filthy delights are turned into direful things.

The man who does not suffer himself to be led to Heaven... is prepared for his place in Hell; for of himself man continually tends to the lowest of Hell, but is continually withheld by the Lord; and he who cannot be withheld, is prepared for a certain place there, to which he is assigned immediately after (death); and this place is opposite to a certain place in Heaven... This is the inmost of the Divine Providence concerning Hell.
The delight of evil, perceived as good, is Hell.

When a man does not will evil because it is from Hell... he is then in the first degree of reformation, and is at the threshold from Hell into Heaven... When he... resolves to desist from evils, he is in the second degree of reformation, and is then outside Hell, but not yet in Heaven...
(The three degrees of light in Hell. Described.)
As all, even the evil, fear Hell...

The cause of his leading himself deeper into evil, is that he introduces himself more and more interiorly... into infernal Societies... He who has (done this) becomes as it were bound with cords... In the world they are as soft wool... but after death they become hard...

Every evil man is in an infernal Society... and he sometimes appears there, when he is in deep meditation.
All Hell is nothing but the form of all the concupiscences of evil...
That the Lord rules Hell by opposites; and that the evil who are in the world He rules in Hell as to the interiors, and not as to the exteriors. General article. DP 307, Explained.

All in Hell are nothing but concupiscences of evil and the derivative imaginations of falsity; which are so ordinated that (they) are exactly opposite to the affections of good and thoughts of truth in Heaven; and therefore Hell is beneath Heaven, being diametrically opposite to it... as the antipodes are... Sometimes Hell so appears in relation to Heaven... The reason is that those in Hell make the concupiscences of evil the head, and the affections of good the feet...

The delight of his concupiscence infills and surrounds every Spirit of Hell; the general delight, every Society of Hell; and the most general delight, the whole Hell. That the Lord rules in Hell the evil who are in the world. Explained.

He who is in evil love goes to Hell; nor does he rest except in the Society where his reigning love is; and... everyone knows the way... as if he smelled it.

These cast evils back to Hell... in proportion as they shun them as sins. Explained.

Hence man does not know that Hell is in the affections of the love of evil.
That by the strong influx of the Lord from Heaven, that religiosity with all its adulterated truths of the Word, will be cast headlong into Hell. Signified, Explained.

That all these were cast as they were into Hell, where are the loves of falsity together with the cupidities of evil. Signified, Explained.

The Hell where such are appears at a distance as a fiery lake with a green flame like that of sulphur; but they who are in it do not see this, for they are shut up in their workhouses, where they have vehement altercations with one another...

Beneath their Hells are workhouses, into which those fall who inflict injury on others; for his phantasy is left to everyone in Hell, and also glorying therein; but he is not allowed to do evil to another...

It was granted to look into their Hells; and the Hell where were the emperors of emperors and kings of kings was full of all uncleanness... In like manner in the other Hell where were the gods and the god of gods...

Hell is under thy feet.

The Angel said. Come up hither, and I will show you to the life what Heaven is, and what Hell...

As to the quality of Hell: it consists of myriads of myriads, because it consists of all those who from the creation have estranged themselves from God by evils of life and falsities of faith.
The ordination of the Heavens and the Hells, since the Last Judgment... is still going on.

A memorable truth: - That the Church which is in Divine truths from the Lord prevails over the Hells. Signified, Explained.
